events.description: Monica Geller says Monica Geller cannot believe Chandler Bing still has not informed Nina Bookbinder about her employment status.
Monica Geller says Chandler Bing still has not told Nina Bookbinder that Nina Bookbinder does not have a job yet.
Chandler Bing says Monica Geller still has not taken down the Christmas lights.
Monica Geller says Chandler Bing has come up with the world's thinnest argument.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing is trying to find the right moment to tell Nina Bookbinder that she does not have a job.

Rachel Green says Chandler Bing is dating Nina Bookbinder.
Rachel Green says Chandler Bing should fire Nina Bookbinder.
Rachel Green says that, in her hypothetical scenario, Chandler Bing would go to work after firing Nina Bookbinder.

Monica Geller says Monica Geller will get the door.

Monica Geller says Monica Geller, Chandler Bing, Rachel Green, Joey Tribbiani, and Phoebe Buffay are just sitting around talking quietly and not doing anything noisy.

Joey Tribbiani asks Phoebe Buffay to do Joey Tribbiani a favor.

Phoebe Buffay says the present is really nice.
Joey Tribbiani says the present is for Ursula Buffay.

Chandler Bing says Joey Tribbiani's relationship with Ursula Buffay is serious.
Chandler Bing says he has never known Joey Tribbiani to pay money for any kind of capade.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani likes Ursula Buffay, that Ursula Buffay is different, and that there is something about Ursula Buffay that appeals to Joey Tribbiani.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani asked Phoebe Buffay for permission about Joey Tribbiani dating Ursula Buffay.
